description: On-chain activity traces for AI agents on devnet (Anchor 0.29): an agent wallet registers, logs each action as a hashed trace PDA, and earns a trust level from its activity count and age. initialize_agent, log_activity and verify_trace verified with real transactions.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of nizarsyahmi37/verifiagent. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/verifiagent. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (agent registry, trace logging, trust levels)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/verifiagent/
QA: devnet proof of agent activity traces
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Add a third-party attestation to traces
